_comment: Brotli byte budget for each extension's production file (packages/<name>/dist/<file>.min.js.br, the manifest output with minify: true). scripts/test-extension.cjs compares the built file against its number here as the size leg, and fails it when the file is over. The only way past a failure is to raise the number here, in the same change as the code that needed it, with `since` and `why` filled in, so every raise sits in a commit diff beside its cause. When a file lands more than 200 B under budget the leg prints the new floor; lower the budget to accept the win. Kept at the root, not in each package.json, because npm publishes every package.json whatever `files` says, and this is the repo's process, not the user's. Until 2026-10-28 each budget lived in its package.json as wildflower.budget; the earlier raises and their reasons are in that file's git history.

kinetic.why: +853 B (measured 77890 B): fixes for 0.2.0. A look move after another look keeps its target and travels an arc about it, and a top-down look no longer flips on its landing frame (543 B of it, measured when the arc went in); under ?embed the speaker button and the pause mark stay, and an element added beside the root later is hidden by an observer; the fit scales by the root's laid-out width; render.still(t) within a frame of the end; a step or scrub made while As Rendered draws is kept and gone to after, a seek while paused redraws it, Render and Check are off while a frame draws, and the still is cleared with the bar; timeOf('frame N') counts at the composition's own rate (the root's data-fps, else config({ fps }), else 30), never a render's; camera() and cameraAt() given a function are KN-100; the VERSION constant at 0.2.0. Before that, 77037 (2026-11-08 the bar's frame notice): +265 B (measured 77037 B): in a page inside a frame, the preview bar's Render shows a notice first, once a page load, that the site around it may block the download and the file opened in Chrome directly is sure, with Render anyway and Close; config({ frameNotice: false }) turns it off and config() reports it. Before that, 76772 (2026-11-08 moves() and look()): +2028 B (measured 76772 B): moves(list, options), a camera built from a list of moves as a function of time returning cameraAt()'s numbers: moves add, each landing on its to at t + d plus its lag and holding, so overlaps blend and a lagged key keeps moving with the move before; ease (power2.inOut, or 'attack' for fast in and a long settle), lag, over, kick on the turns, swing on the positions, drift that rises over its move and falls away over the next, dolly at a steady rate of zoom toward a plane, a look move ({ eye, at }) that interpolates the eye and the target with lag, over and swing on 'eye.x' to 'at.z', and a function move joined over blend seconds and handed on at its speed; look(eye, at, { perspective }), the camera's numbers for an eye looking at a point; KN-100 naming the entry and field for each malformed move, KN-121 for an unknown ease. Before that, 74744 (2026-11-07 a finish that changes over time): +347 B (measured 74744 B): any finish part but the grain's fps may be a track { at, to, ease } of numbers in its range, read at each frame's time (frame / fps), so the render's pass refills its uniforms per frame and the bloom's and diffusion's blur radii follow; a track alone is a field's amount; a field 0 at every key is off; config() reports a track as a copy; the live overlays' values follow the tracks on every seek; KN-100 for a track on the grain's fps, out of range or with a unit, KN-120 for a malformed track. Before that, 74397 (2026-11-07 the view: data-viewmode and viewmode()): +114 B (measured 74397 B): the store's `viewmode`, 'render' while check() or render() runs or a render captures and 'live' otherwise, or the view a tool holds through self.__KINETIC_VIEW (check.cjs --view); wildflower.kinetic.viewmode(); a sheet of Kinetic's own that hides data-viewmode="render" in the live view and data-viewmode="live" in the render view, by a marker on <html>. Before that, 74283 (2026-11-05 cameraAt() and depth(z, { detail, camera })): +143 B (measured 74283 B): cameraAt(t, tracks, { shake }), the camera's numbers at t, which camera() is now built from; depth(z, { detail, camera }), a layer drawn k times finer through CSS zoom and moved along the lines from the eye so the picture is the same, since Chrome draws a layer under a turned camera at its CSS size and stretches it; a layer the camera has passed left behind the eye, undrawn, as a plain one is; KN-100 for a detail outside 1 to 8 and a missing camera. Before that, 74140 (2026-11-04 the bar's As Rendered, finish: { diffuse }, and the fit by height in a top-level window): +797 B (measured 74140 B): As Rendered on the preview bar, on a piece with a finish or a shutter: the paused frame through render()'s own seeks, shutter and finish (render.still(t), the frame kept as a canvas, no encoder, no sound) laid over the root, drawn again on each step or scrub, steps made while it draws drawn once after, off on play, render and check, and KN-201 named on the bar; finish: { diffuse: { amount, radius } }, the whole frame blurred at a quarter size and mixed over it, the bloom's three-pass chain shared by both; the fit's wrapper no wider than lets the stage fit the window above the bar in a top-level window, the bar watched for its height and the window for resizes, the scale from the wrapper's exact width. Before that, 73343 (2026-11-04 land(), arrival(), onFrame(), tempo().frame() and beat and frame times in timeOf()): +349 B (measured 73343 B): land(t, at, duration, ease), a ramp started so the move arrives at `at`, the first moment within 3% of its end; arrival(ease, duration), that lead in seconds, found by stepping and halving and kept per ease; onFrame(t) and tempo().frame(n), a time on its nearest frame at the composition's rate; 'beat 9' and 'frame 170' in timeOf(); KN-100 for each. Before that, 72994 (2026-11-04 config({ encode }); a finished render's message stays on the bar): +193 B (measured 72994 B): config({ encode }) sets render()'s codec, bitrate, audioCodec and audioBitrate, so the preview bar's Render button uses them, with one check shared by render() and config() and KN-100 naming the field under encode; the default bitrate 16 Mbps; the bar's 'render complete' line stays until the next thing done on it. Before that, 72801 (2026-11-01 0.1.2: the VERSION constant at 0.1.2): +29 B (measured 72801 B): the VERSION constant at 0.1.2, Brotli's own variation on a one-character change. Before that, 72772 (2026-11-01 captions() balances its lines): +287 B (measured 72772 B): captions() splits each run of words between forced breaks into the fewest lines maxWords and maxChars allow, as near equal in length as they can be, preferring a break after a clause's end. Before that, 72485 (2026-11-01 text() takes any axis the outlines hold): +6 B (measured 72485 B): text()'s line and letter values accept any axis the outlines were baked with, by its tag (such as Shantell Sans's BNCE), beside wght and slnt. Before that, 72479 (2026-11-01 a page's own sound button, Chrome 157's canvas painting, KN-131 on a page opened from disk): +42 B (measured 72479 B): config({ sound: true }) from a click resumes the audio and the speaker leaves it on; a canvas copy's bitmap is its content box from Chrome 157 (CONTENT_BOX_PAINT); KN-131's sentence names a page opened from disk (development builds). Before that, 72437 (2026-10-31 every footage seek waits for a presented frame; the dust drawn on the CPU): +41 B (measured 72437 B): every footage seek, not only one onto the end of the file, settles once the element has presented a frame, and the finish's dust canvas is created willReadFrequently so a repeated frame draws the same pixels in Chrome; the VERSION constant at 0.1.0. Before that, 72396 (2026-10-28 an end-of-file footage seek waits for a presented frame): +90 B over the 72306 B build before it (measured 72396 B): a footage seek onto the end of its file settles once the element has presented a frame (requestVideoFrameCallback) as well as ended, since ended reads only the position. Before that, +193 B (measured 72364 B): an image still loading after 30 s fails readiness (KN-182), a footage seek not landed in 30 s is KN-138, the clock's seek fails on a media hook's rejection, and config() reports the finish as named parts. Before that, +672 B (measured 72171 B) for the review's low findings, +3 B (71499 B) for KN-192 in the code table, +564 B (71496 B) for the review's high and medium findings; each raise's full list of causes, and every raise before them, is in the git history of packages/kinetic/package.json.

kinetic.25d.why: +256 B (measured 4461 B): every camera, light, rim and glow number, center, across, and add()'s albedo and glow are checked (KN-100 naming the option), and set() with an unknown key is KN-100; a shape scaled to 0 on an axis is skipped where draw() threw; a face with no normal is culled; each end of a face's gradient is held in front of the near plane, so a face that crosses it keeps its gradient on the part drawn. Before that, 4205 (2026-11-04 kinetic.25d.js, first budget): 4205 B (measured): the first build of kinetic.25d.js, Kinetic's second file, wildflower.kinetic.solids: box, cage and faces; the camera with near clipping and a fade; culling and the far-to-near sort broken by place on screen; shading through a ramp with a gradient across each face; the rim; glows from the projection's local slope, with bleeds in a flat-color layer per light; paths written clockwise from the leftmost corner; a slot per face made when its shape is added; KN-100 for its arguments.

three.why: +79 B over 7183 (measured 7262 B): uniform() returns a function that stops it, sets a number into a Color target and settles a typed-array target of another length; view.draw() inside a frame does nothing, with the 3D-115 warning in development builds. Before that, +180 B over 7003: video(texture), a texture of a <video> uploaded on the next frame after the video's currentTime moves (not while it seeks or has no frame) and drawn under render: 'change', with the function that stops it, the store's method, the clean-up on dispose, and the 3D-114 check and message. Before that, +11 B over 6992: projectPoint(x, y, z, camera) projects through a given camera, and the store's method passes it on. Before that, +481 B over 6511: quaternion and rotation (Euler) fields through three.js's own Quaternion and Matrix4.compose(), a per-axis scale on every way of setting the rotation, quaternion offsets in buffer(), and projectPoint() bringing the camera's matrices up to date, 324 B; the 3D-104 and 3D-105 checks of the new array fields 81 B, and of quaternion or rotation beside another rotation field 76 B, each measured as what the min build loses when it alone is taken out. Before that, 6511: first budget, set at the 2026-10-08 build
